visualStandard.scope: Transversal: cards, panels, bloques informativos, cajas de contenido, contenedores secundarios, fondos de sección y bordes.
requirements: Increase contrast between page/section background and cards without making the interface aggressive.
Increase visual separation between functional blocks.
Use borders, elevation, whitespace and restrained background changes consistently.
Preserve the approved typography family and scale; do not reintroduce mixed typographies.
Use Gravicentra brand color grammar consistently; yellow/amber is reserved for pending/warning semantics, not as a generic redesign accent.
visualStandard.reviewRule: No visual PASS from machine proof alone. Human review must explicitly inspect hierarchy, contrast, typography consistency and block separation on each changed surface.

whatsappArchitecture.intent: Centralize WhatsApp-origin interactions and link them to canonical Clientes, Negocios/Gestiones and collaboration history.
preferredModel: Treat Gravicentra as system of record for business entities and workflow state.
Receive supported WhatsApp Business Platform messages/events via webhook and resolve sender/group context to client/business/management records.
Store a canonical conversation/event reference, not raw secrets, and surface actions from the linked Client/Lead/Ops record.
Do not make WhatsApp Communities an assumed programmable backend until official API support/eligibility is proven for the tenant.
If supported group messaging is available for the tenant, model group/channel identifiers separately from client phone identities and require explicit mapping/audit.
whatsappArchitecture.b4003Impact: Do not expand current B4-003 into a new external integration build. Preserve this as a frozen architecture requirement; current Ops/Leads collaboration must remain provider-agnostic so WhatsApp can attach later without redesign.

findingExtension.closureCondition: Paula targeted Preview review confirms contrast, separation, hierarchy and typography consistency across Ops/Leads modal+cards, inbox, Aseguradoras three workbenches and Calidad.
